title: GET /events response (B.2 change feed)
description: ?after=<seq>&limit=<=1000&types=task.*,goal.*&excludeOrigin=gauzy:<id>. Only pinned orgs and only non-private aggregates. Events are in ascending seq order. `nextCursor` is the seq to pass as `after` next time (null when there is nothing after this page); `head` is the newest seq visible to the key. A cursor older than retention answers 410 cursor_expired (full resync). task.runtime_updated is excluded unless `types` names it explicitly.
